description: Canonical browser action contract shared by the Desktop (chromiumoxide) and Docker (Playwright) editions. Action names are edition-neutral; each edition maps its own tool surface onto them. This file is data, not a runtime dependency: Desktop embeds it at compile time and Docker copies it into the image.

navigate.description: Load a URL in the active tab.

click.description: Click the element named by a CSS selector or a snapshot ref.

click_at.description: Click viewport coordinates. Used by the manual takeover surface.

type.description: Focus an element and type text with real keyboard events.

type_active.description: Type into the currently focused element.

press.description: Press a keyboard key (Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown, ...).

hover.description: Move the mouse over an element.

select.description: Choose an option in a native select element.

check.description: Set a checkbox or radio button state.

scroll.description: Scroll the viewport by a delta.

dom.description: Return capped innerHTML for a selector (or the body).

extract.description: Return structured text and href values for matching elements.

snapshot.description: Return a capped accessibility-oriented element tree with stable refs.

evaluate.description: Evaluate a bounded JavaScript expression in the page.

wait_for.description: Wait for selector, URL, text, function or document load.

info.description: Read the active tab URL and title.

back.description: Go back in the active tab's history.

forward.description: Go forward in the active tab's history.

new_tab.description: Open a new tab and make it active.

close_tab.description: Close a tab (the active tab when omitted).

close.description: Close every browser tab and shut Chromium down.
